description: This file defines the CalculatedFieldsService class, which provides methods for managing calculated fields via HTTP requests in an Angular application. It includes methods for CRUD operations, querying, testing scripts, and retrieving debug events related to calculated fields.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldsService
classes.description: Angular service class for handling calculated fields operations via HTTP API.

methods.name: getCalculatedFieldById
methods.description: Fetches a calculated field by its ID.

methods.name: saveCalculatedField
methods.description: Saves a calculated field (create or update).

methods.name: deleteCalculatedField
methods.description: Deletes a calculated field by its ID.

methods.name: getCalculatedFields
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of calculated fields based on query parameters.

methods.name: getCalculatedFieldsByEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves calculated fields associated with a specific entity ID.

methods.name: testScript
methods.description: Tests a calculated field script with provided input parameters.

methods.name: getLatestCalculatedFieldDebugEvent
methods.description: Fetches the latest debug event for a specific calculated field.

methods.name: getCalculatedFieldNames
methods.description: Retrieves names of calculated fields with pagination and filtering by type.
